scope: All available OCT/OCTA experiment code, configs, numeric records and rendered result panels in selected local/server research directories.
excluded: unrelated slide decks and paper asset copies
notes: Public dataset case numbers are pseudonymous dataset labels, not private real identities.
Historical Python/shell sources are copied byte-for-byte; machine paths in them require local configuration before reuse.
Original text/JSON paths are replaced with example paths; original and published hashes are separately recorded.
Different local and server versions of the same file are retained in local_snapshots.
Archived weights and raw arrays referenced in reports are intentionally absent; this is a review archive, not a self-contained training dataset.
